policy.player_contact: stop_without_pushing; pedestrian may reverse only after checking free swept capsule
policy.vehicle_contact: stop for any player/pedestrian/vehicle on forward swept corridor; no push or forced reset
policy.vehicle_end: brake_to_stop_and_wait; no U-turn or reverse drive
policy.scope: Planning guards and geometry only; N02/N03 implement and observe actual stopping, visibility and repeated motion

assumptions.lane: oneway and lanes from OSM; physical lane centres, permitted lane use and widths unverified. Lane index4/3.2m/right1.6m is an authored game assumption. XZ right=(-dz,+dx), Shapely positive offset.
assumptions.ground: y=0 technical support assumption retained; no surveyed road or terrain
assumptions.repeat: NPC ping-pong turns in place. Vehicle stream recycle is permitted only under future visibility/dynamic-clearance guards; if visible or occupied it remains stopped. No invented physical return link.
assumptions.access: Selected G04 road candidates are promoted only to these bounded game corridors; real-world access remains unverified; original permissions stay null.
assumptions.mode_domains: NPC centres: existing W03 movement, full capsules: existing support. Vehicle domain: selected G04 road candidate clipped to background extent; G04 candidate_geometry is the walking-review envelope, not a universal traffic boundary. No free access inferred from either bounding box.
